entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
Okay, I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. It's just hard to use. Frankly, I expected more from the interface for the price.
I understand your frustration. Could you tell me a bit more about what you're finding confusing? That will help me understand if it's something we can resolve.
The live workout data. I can't see my heart rate zones while I'm running. The user manual is useless, it just shows a picture of the final summary screen.

Ah, I can definitely help with that. It's a common point of confusion but a very easy fix. While a workout is active, you just need to double-tap the screen to cycle through the different data displays.
Double-tap? That's it? Hold on, I have it here...
Yes, the default screen is often pace or distance. A double-tap should bring up the heart rate zone graph.
Well, I'll be. There it is. Okay. Why isn't that the default? That's the whole reason I bought it.

That's excellent feedback, and you can actually customize that. If you go into the VeloFit app on your phone, under 'Device Settings' and then 'Workout Displays,' you can drag the Heart Rate Zone screen to the number one position. It will then be the first thing you see when you start a workout.
Okay. That... actually solves my entire problem. I was about to send it back.
I'm very glad we could get that sorted out for you! It's a powerful device, and we want to make sure you're getting the most out of it. Now that we've fixed that, are you happy to keep the VeloBand?
Yeah, fine. This works. I'll keep it. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
